candidate_rule: first 10000 points from a seeded scrambled Sobol net generated at size 16384 on [0,1]^6; no analytic minimizer is injected

initial_kernel_calibration.posterior_mean_rkhs_norm_rule: maximum across all held-out initial-GP posterior-mean RKHS norms

hartmann6.rkhs_norm_definition: quantile 0.75 of held-out initial-GP posterior-mean RKHS norms, multiplied by the prespecified shrinkage factor 0.5

reference_rkhs_rule: quantile 0.75 of noise-regularized initial-GP posterior-mean RKHS norms over 240 held-out calibration fits; the exact 512-point interpolant norm is retained only as a diagnostic
